name: google-workspace
description: Google Docs, Sheets and Slides for your agents, plus Drive to find files: search and read anything in the account, write documents as markdown, create files, and comment.

setup.title: What your agents can do
setup.body: Agents can search your Google Drive and read any Doc, Sheet or Slides file this Google account can open. They can create new files and edit Docs, Sheets and Slides you can edit (adding, inserting and replacing text are allowed by default). Replacing a whole document or moving a file to the Trash asks you first; the Trash only works for files the extension created, and nothing is deleted for good. Nothing here changes who files are shared with.

setup.title: The permissions Google will ask for
setup.body: Docs, Sheets and Slides (edit): read and change those files' content. Drive, view only: search, list folders, read file details and comments, and export files. Drive, files this app creates: put new files in Drive and comment on them; the extension can't change or delete your other Drive files through Drive. Approve all of them: a missing one makes some tools say "reconnect".
